phase_protocol.phase: phi_n,pair(a) = atan2 of the pair of the unit-L2 K address BEFORE RoPE (no theta*pos_n) for K components; atan2 of the V pair for V components; both components of a pair share the phase
phase_protocol.phase_input: the address direction itself; no phase parameters (theta_k_raw/theta_v_raw allocated but unused, no gradient)
phase_protocol.phase_initialization: same original theta and other parameter draws; zero correction
phase_protocol.write: G_ij=sum_n V_ni K_nj L(phiV_ni-phiK_nj); read=RoPE(Q)@G.T; Q,K = x/(||x||_2+eps) per token/head before RoPE, eps=config eps
phase_protocol.normalization: RMSNorm immediately after each attention/FFN residual; FP32 mean square, eps1e-5, no affine; count=2
phase_protocol.window_note: 2pi-periodized tanh*sech: W(d) = s * sum_r b_r sin(r d), b_r = tau_phi^2 r sech(pi r tau_phi/2); s sets peak 1. Computed with the verified feature-write operator (R sin/cos feature GEMMs).
phase_protocol.scope: Short controlled research experiment; max_steps applies only to this new diagnostic run
phase_protocol.checkpoints: Periodic saves every 1000 steps plus trainer saves at evaluation boundaries and terminal; keep_last=25; all step logs retained
phase_protocol.original_training: local_warp_exp stopped by user at step 30550; not resumed
phase_protocol.read: RoPE(Q) @ G.T unchanged (q/k phase match kept inside the Hebbian product)
phase_protocol.interpretation: phase-locked oscillators at a common frequency; omega enters only through tau_phi
phase_protocol.baseline: 2026-10-09 pairangle unrotated (alpha -> window only) and 2026-10-08 B-only + QK L2 + token sum (alpha = 0)
phase_protocol.position_invariance: the window is a per-pair scalar of content only, so it commutes with the RoPE rotation; the read depends on positions only through pos_t - pos_n, as in B-only
phase_protocol.window_general: general STDP window c0 + alpha_h W: c0 = net integral of the time window (rate-Hebbian term, Kempter et al. 1999), W = odd timing part; c0 fixed to 1 (scale absorbed by V/out_proj), alpha_h learned per head, unbounded; init alpha_h = 1
